boundaries: Agreement with human ratings is not sufficient evidence of construct or predictive validity.
A scorer that matches aggregate distributions may still miss unusual valid answers or create subgroup error.
claim_ceiling: Generated project-scoped candidate Definition record only. Shape and projection checks grant no Lab admission, semantic truth, implementation, collection or employment-use authority.

scope.applicability: One scoring version and compatible cases, rubrics and response modes.
exclusions: Any other product or Lab-wide meaning without separate owner review and admission.

domain_context.explanation: Candidate Scorer Evaluation meaning for the Engineer Assessment product and research program. Its construct, implementation and use claims remain bounded by the source statement.

plain_language.explanation: It tests whether the scoring method reads answers correctly and whether its scores mean anything useful.

boundary_conditions: Agreement with human ratings is not sufficient evidence of construct or predictive validity.
A scorer that matches aggregate distributions may still miss unusual valid answers or create subgroup error.
scientific_formal.normative_statement: A Scorer Evaluation is a versioned test of a pinned human or automated scoring procedure against independent anchored ratings, evidence spans, adversarial responses, mode changes and downstream criteria under a declared population and use.
